card.name: Small linking words in trial reporting
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as the, their, at, from, by and and in clinical trial results, just before a reference point like baseline, time of maximum concentration, or a dose level.

modes.label: the/their before a reference point
modes.description: The word the or their comes right before a trial reference such as time of maximum concentration or target dose.
modes.example: change in QTc from the pre-dose value at<< the>> time of maximum drug concentration was 6

modes.label: from/at/and before baseline
modes.description: A short linking word comes before the word baseline or endpoint in change-from-baseline reporting.
modes.example: The proportion of patients with weight gain >7% increase<< from>> baseline was 4%, 12

card.writes: It seems to push toward words like main, core and testing, which fit trial-design wording.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words in clinical trial results, just before a baseline or reference-point term.
